opportunity: A pointer-width value the program uses only as an array of one element type -- a parameter indexed byte by byte, the buffer malloc returned, a global that holds an allocated table, a constant table in .data read with a computed index -- is declared long or void * (or not at all), so every access prints as an integer sum behind casts: *(char *)((long)v6 + (long)v8), *(unsigned char *)((long)v1 + 0x4020). TypeOpIntAdd votes an integer for both operands of p + i and refuses to carry the loaded element's pointer back over the add (typeop.cc:1217).
